name: vault-browse-five-shapes-v1
purpose: Visibility Phase 2, Slice J1-Vault. Five synthetic physical shapes exercising the rebuilt Vault Browse face's classification and card contract in one self-contained journey fixture: two films (poster cards, carousel-eligible arrivals), one show assembled from two sibling season folders (collapses to one poster show card at root, the Loki shape), and one plain folder of loose, non-episode-shaped clips (a Folder node at root; drilling in renders its two loose files as Clip nodes -> 16:9 wide cards, the Cricket shape). Distinct from tests/fixtures/vault/browse-face-smoke (Slice 5-10's own battle-tested fixture) so this journey stays inside its own fence and never resurrects or duplicates that fixture's ownership.
provenance: Authored fresh for J1-Vault (2026-08-14), naming conventions mirrored from the proven tests/fixtures/vault/browse-face-smoke shapes (Loki sibling-season show, Spider-Man lone film, Cricket plain folder) per VaultKit.cpp's real classifyChildDirectory()/planBrowseLevel() rules (read, not modified). Not lifted from a real-bug dossier; not promoted into tests/lanista-seeds/ in this slice.
confirmedRoot: media/ (this fixture directory) — vault/config.json points a confirmed root directly at the absolute path of this fixture's own media/ subtree, exactly as tests/fixtures/vault/browse-face-smoke-seed does for its sibling fixture. VaultLibrary::republishAtBoot() scans+publishes this root automatically at boot; no pre-built index is seeded.

shapes.note: sibling-candidate; merges with Season 2 into one 'Journey Show' show card at root (the Loki shape)
sibling of Season 1; the pair's merged key is '<mediaRoot>::show::journey show'
two loose, non-episode-shaped files (no SxxExx, no absolute '- NNN' token) -> a plain Folder at root; drilling in renders both as Clip nodes (16:9 wide cards)

expectedRootGridOrder: Journey Show (show, merged from its two season siblings)
note: Locked design §4.2 root ordering is folders, then shows, then films, each group sorted by title — confirmed live via dump-ui/qml-get before this fixture's scenario asserted on it, per the plan's own instruction not to assert blind.
